<subject>Re: Iron Ore Social</subject>
<body>
I'm an expert at being a rabid fan and excellent arm chair manager.  I keep waiting for the Kalgoorlie to call for advice...


 
"Devin King" <devin.king@tasmanridge.com.au> on 29/03/2024 04:28:25 PM
To: <adam.costa@tasmanridge.com.au>
cc:  

Subject: Re: Iron Ore Social

Sorry for the late notice - have been underwater this week trying to get Pilbara Rail and Karara Iron buttoned up, and just realized today that I needed to get on this.  Will hope to see you there and try to find another time we can go. My understanding from all is that you are the resident Aussie Rules expert (next to Robert Stanley).

Best regards.

cgt
</body>
<quoted>
>>> <adam.costa@tasmanridge.com.au> 29/03/24 04:12PM >>>

I would love to take you up on it, but I'm already lined up to go.  I'll take a raincheck!

Thanks for thinking of me.

Adam




"Devin King" <devin.king@tasmanridge.com.au> on 29/03/2024 04:07:45 PM

To:   <margaret.cox@tasmanridge.com.au>, <adam.costa@tasmanridge.com.au>, <eric.moore@tasmanridge.com.au>
cc:

Subject:  Iron Ore Social

My recollection is that each of you is somewhat of a sports fan, as I am. I just happen to have 4 great seats for the West Coast Eagles game at Tasman Ridge Stadium, for which I very much need company to help me enjoy.  I would love it if each of you could join me.  The game starts at 4:05 pm, so it might require leaving the office a little early.  But of course we would be discussing serious business the entire time so that it would be fully justifiable to anyone interested.  I will bring my legal pad to take notes.

Let me know.  Hope you can come.

cgt
